item.title: Wild West Comedy Musical is Coming to Historic Fayette Theater
item.description: The Historic Fayette Theater is about to open its final production before a major renovation of the theater starts, and this play is bringing the wild west to Southern West Virginia.

item.title: Tazewell County Regional Drug and Violent Crime Task Force made several arrests and seized drugs in Operation Phoenix
item.description: The Tazewell County Regional Drug and Violent Crime Task Force says it made seven arrests and seized crystal meth and cocaine following a targeted law enforcement operation.

item.title: Last day of school revealed for Fayette and Raleigh counties
item.description: Raleigh County and Fayette County schools both say they have received approval to cut five instructional days from their schedule.

item.title: Governor Patrick Morrisey took his income tax cut campaign to Greenbrier County
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey took his income tax cut campaign to Greenbrier County Thursday at the state fairgrounds as the current legislative session enters its final days.

item.title: Oak Hill Fire Department to honor the memory of past firefighters
item.description: On Sunday, March 29, at 2 p.m. at the Oak Hill Fire Department, they will host a ceremony to remember previous members who honorably served their community.

item.title: Out of the Darkness walk to prevent suicide
